name: Accordion
description: A list of labelled disclosure regions with shared single or multiple expansion behavior.

id.description: Stable DOM id prefix for trigger and panel relationships.

openItems.description: Controlled ordered list of open item ids.

defaultOpenItems.description: Initial open item ids when openItems is omitted.

multiple.description: Allows more than one enabled panel to remain open.

openChange.description: Reports the next ordered open item ids after user activation.
